title: Power plants · Global Energy Monitor · generating units
description: Power generating units and phases of the world from the Global Integrated Power Tracker of Global Energy Monitor (GEM), September 2026 release: one row for each of the 164,672 units of the tracker that GEM does not mark as sourced from TransitionZero's Solar Asset Mapper. The tracker compiles GEM's eight trackers of coal, oil and gas, utility-scale solar, wind, hydropower, nuclear, bioenergy and geothermal power, each with its own capacity threshold. Units of all GEM statuses are included, from announced to retired, so capacity should be added up only within one status. GEM's fields are copied unchanged. The project adds the GEM base status, a size class, country codes in its boundary frame and a code for GEM's two data-center flags. The 18,732 units that GEM marks as sourced from TransitionZero are published separately, in abf-energync under CC BY-NC 4.0. This layer is published as files; the map shows energy_plants_gem_locations.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: GEM unit/phase ID: GEM's key of the unit or phase (G followed by 11 digits).

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: GEM location ID: GEM's key of the plant. All units of a plant share it.

fields.name: plant_name
fields.description: Name of the plant or project, as GEM gives it.

fields.name: unit_name
fields.description: Name or number of the unit or phase, as GEM gives it.
fields.null_meaning: GEM gives no unit or phase name.

fields.name: type
fields.description: One of GEM's eight power technology groups: coal, oil/gas, utility-scale solar, wind, hydropower, nuclear, bioenergy, geothermal.

fields.name: technology
fields.description: Technology as GEM gives it, for example run-of-river, pumped storage or offshore hard mount. Offshore wind and pumped-storage hydropower are told apart only in this field.
fields.null_meaning: GEM gives no technology. All bioenergy units are without one.

fields.name: fuel
fields.description: Fuel of a combustion unit, as GEM gives it.
fields.null_meaning: Not a combustion unit, or GEM gives no fuel.

fields.name: capacity_mw
fields.description: Capacity in megawatts as GEM gives it. GEM defines it as “Total nameplate capacity, or best available data, of the project, in megawatts”. For solar units, see capacity_rating.

fields.name: capacity_rating
fields.description: Solar units only: whether GEM gives the capacity as an AC value (MWac), as a DC or peak value (MWp/dc), or unknown.

fields.name: capacity_class
fields.description: Size class of capacity_mw: lt10 (under 10 MW), 10_99 (10 to under 100 MW), 100_999 (100 to under 1,000 MW), ge1000 (1,000 MW and more). A capacity of 0 is in lt10.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status as GEM gives it: one of GEM's eight base statuses or one of two statuses that GEM infers, shelved - inferred 2 y and cancelled - inferred 4 y.

fields.name: status_group
fields.description: GEM base status: announced, pre_construction, construction, operating, shelved, cancelled, mothballed or retired. The two inferred statuses are counted under shelved and cancelled.

fields.name: start_year
fields.description: Start year, as GEM gives it.

fields.name: retired_year
fields.description: Year of retirement, as GEM gives it.
fields.null_meaning: Not retired, or GEM gives no year.

fields.name: owners
fields.description: Owners as GEM gives them, with their shares in brackets.

fields.name: operators
fields.description: Operators as GEM gives them.

fields.name: country_area
fields.description: Country or area as GEM names it. GEM notes that this column “presents energy data within various economic contexts, and the geographical unit does not strictly follow political boundaries”.

fields.name: subnational_unit
fields.description: State or province, as GEM gives it.
fields.null_meaning: GEM names no state or province.

fields.name: iso3_gem
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of country_area, from the country table in GEM's own file (sheet Regions, area, and countries).

fields.name: iso3_source
fields.description: Country of the record in the project's boundary frame (ADM0 of abf-boundaries v0.2.0). It equals iso3_gem except for six territories that GEM lists separately and the frame includes in a country: Réunion, Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana and Mayotte are FRA; Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba are NLD (gem_iso3_to_adm0.csv).

fields.name: iso3_frame
fields.description: Country of the frame in which the point lies. For a point outside all countries, the nearest country if it is within 22.2 km (12 nautical miles, the breadth of the territorial sea).
fields.null_meaning: The point lies more than 22.2 km from the land of any country of the frame. Most such units are offshore wind farms.

fields.name: iso3_frame_rule
fields.description: How iso3_frame was found: within (the point lies inside the country) or nearest_12nmi (the point lies outside all countries, and this is the nearest one within 22.2 km).
fields.null_meaning: No country of the frame within 22.2 km (iso3_frame is empty).

fields.name: control_iso3
fields.description: State in control, for a point inside an area of disputed control of abf-boundaries v0.2.0 (contested_areas). In this version: Crimea, under Russian control (RUS), claimed by Ukraine.
fields.null_meaning: The point does not lie in an area of disputed control.

fields.name: location_accuracy
fields.description: exact or approximate, as GEM gives it. GEM: “Approximate based on using nearest city or other information in research, or exact based on visibility on map or given in research”.

fields.name: coord_precision
fields.description: site where GEM gives the location as exact; approximate where GEM gives it as approximate.

fields.name: coord_source
fields.description: gem: the point is GEM's.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, as GEM gives it. The project does not move or round points.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, as GEM gives it. The project does not move or round points.

fields.name: captive_industry_type
fields.description: Industry that a captive plant serves, as GEM gives it, for example data center, aluminum or chemicals.
fields.null_meaning: GEM does not list the unit as a captive plant.

fields.name: data_center_ppa
fields.description: yes where GEM lists the unit as connected to a data center through a power purchase agreement. GEM keeps this field for nuclear and geothermal units only.
fields.null_meaning: GEM gives no value; GEM keeps this field for nuclear and geothermal units only.

fields.name: dc_link
fields.description: The project's code for GEM's two data-center flags: captive_dc where captive_industry_type contains “data center”; dc_ppa where data_center_ppa is yes. The flags are GEM's; the project does not check them.
fields.null_meaning: The unit carries neither data-center flag of GEM.

fields.name: river
fields.description: Hydropower units only: river or watercourse, as GEM gives it.
fields.null_meaning: Not a hydropower unit, or GEM names no watercourse.

fields.name: other_ids_location
fields.description: Identifiers of the plant in other datasets, as GEM lists them (for example OpenStreetMap).
fields.null_meaning: GEM lists no other identifier of the plant.

fields.name: other_ids_unit
fields.description: Identifiers of the unit in other datasets, as GEM lists them (for example OpenStreetMap, or TZ for the TransitionZero Solar Asset Mapper).
fields.null_meaning: GEM lists no other identifier of the unit.

fields.name: wiki_url
fields.description: Page of the plant on GEM.wiki, with GEM's references.

sources.product: Global Integrated Power Tracker, units without a TZ ID

coverage.geography: Power plants of the world (Global Energy Monitor)
known_gaps: The tracker includes plants above thresholds that differ by type: coal 30 MW (all operating and mothballed units, units retired since 2000 and units proposed since 2010); oil and gas 50 MW, and 20 MW in the European Union and the United Kingdom; utility-scale solar 1 MW for operating projects, and more than 20 MW for announced, pre-construction, construction and shelved projects; wind 10 MW; hydropower 30 MW; bioenergy 20 MW; geothermal 1 MW; nuclear no threshold. For some countries, smaller wind (from 1 MW), hydropower and bioenergy (from 10 MW) plants are included where data were readily available. Smaller plants and distributed solar below 1 MW are not in the layer, so its totals are not national capacity.

The tracker joins GEM trackers of different dates: utility-scale solar and wind of February 2026, hydropower and geothermal of March 2026, coal of July 2026, oil and gas and nuclear of August 2026, bioenergy of September 2026. A status or capacity may have changed since the date of its tracker.

GEM gives an approximate location for 73,268 of the 164,672 units (44.5%), which GEM bases on “using nearest city or other information in research”. Units of one plant can have different points: for 399 GEM plants, the latitudes or longitudes of their units differ by more than 1°. Some of these may be errors in the source. The project does not correct points.

The country is given twice: by GEM's country table (iso3_gem, iso3_source) and by the point (iso3_frame). 4,609 units lie outside the generalized 1:10 million country outlines but within 22.2 km of a country, and get the nearest one; 858 units lie farther out, most of them offshore wind, and have no iso3_frame. For 291 units the point lies in another country of the frame than the one GEM names. Some of them lie near borders, where generalized outlines can put a point across the line; others lie in areas that GEM and the frame assign differently, such as Crimea: 34 units that GEM lists under Ukraine lie in Crimea or just off its coast, which the frame shows under Russian control; 31 of them lie inside the area of disputed control and carry control_iso3. Neither is a position of the project.

Hydropower includes pumped storage, in which, as GEM defines it, “The project generates electricity using water which is cycled between a lower and an upper reservoir by a pumping system.” Offshore wind is not a type of its own. Both are told apart only by technology.

Solar capacity mixes AC and DC values. GEM notes: “Capacity may be reported as the DC / peak value the arrays could provide or as the AC value of what will be tied into the grid. This is often not specified and could be either value when reported as just 'MW'.” capacity_rating gives the basis where GEM knows it.

Two units have a capacity of 0 MW in GEM: G100001094818 (China Coal Bengbu power station, pre-construction) and G100001023514 (Guodian Chaohu Distributed Gas power station, cancelled - inferred 4 y). The value is published as given, in class lt10.

The statuses shelved - inferred 2 y (2,809 units) and cancelled - inferred 4 y (2,989 units) are GEM's own inference from “lack of observed progress” for two or four years, not a report by the owner. They are counted under shelved and cancelled.

GEM marks 18,732 utility-scale solar units (84,304 MW) as partially or fully sourced from TransitionZero's Solar Asset Mapper, which is under CC BY-NC 4.0. They are not in this dataset, which is under CC BY 4.0, but in abf-energync. 15 plants have units in both datasets.

In the United States, this layer and the project's layers from Form EIA-860 of the U.S. Energy Information Administration are separate sources and are not reconciled. Their figures for the same state can differ.

The two data-center flags are GEM's, published as GEM gives them; the project does not check them. captive_dc: 399 units (227,213 MW of all statuses; 29 operating units, 6,496 MW) that GEM lists as captive plants of a data center, which GEM describes as plants “within industrial facilities” that “typically supply most of their power” to the facility. dc_ppa: 32 nuclear and geothermal units (11,404 MW) that GEM lists as “connected to a data center through a PPA”. GEM keeps the PPA field for nuclear and geothermal only, so a power purchase agreement with a plant of another type is not flagged. A unit without a flag may still supply a data center.

verification.method: The units are copied by script from the sheet Power facilities of the GEM file with the stated SHA-256. The build stops if the file differs, if the number of units or the capacity by type and status differs from the sheet, if a status is not in the table of base statuses, if a GEM country name has no row in GEM's own country table, or if a country code is neither a country of the frame nor a row of gem_iso3_to_adm0.csv. A row of that table is accepted by script only if all points of the code lie in one country of the frame and none lies in an area of disputed control; the six rows of this version were also checked against the official status of the territories. A second run gives byte-identical files. The project did not check GEM's records against other sources: the values are GEM's.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
record_id is present and unique in all 164,672 records.
Records with coord_precision  have no coordinates; every other record has a longitude and a latitude in range.
Every value of iso3_source, iso3_frame, control_iso3 is the ISO 3166 alpha-3 code of a country or territory of the boundaries release.
The fields type, capacity_class, status_group, iso3_frame_rule, location_accuracy, coord_precision, coord_source hold only the values listed in their descriptions.

Recomputed from the published file and equal to the numbers in the texts of this layer: the number of records (164,672); the counts by coord_precision, iso3_frame_rule, status, dc_link; the numbers of records and groups with control_iso3, dc_link; the number of zero values of capacity_mw.
Every record has a non-empty wiki_url (reference to the source record).
The published CSV is byte-identical to the file of the data step (same SHA-256).
